description: This file defines the OverloadDetector class responsible for determining whether a process is overloaded based on environment statistics and configuration options. It includes logic for periodic refresh of the overload status and exposes properties and methods relevant for overload detection within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: OverloadDetector
classes.description: A class to detect if the Orleans process is overloaded based on environment statistics and load shedding options.

methods.name: OverloadDetector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the overload detector with environment statistics provider and load shedding options.

methods.name: ForceRefresh
methods.description: Method to reset the overload status, primarily for testing purposes.
